role: CI gate: every http(s) host literal in app/watch Swift must be on a reviewed allowlist; no analytics/crash SDK names in pbxproj/Package.resolved; no Zip import/unzip call and no Polar firmware-update API (CVE-2023-39135 reachability).
toplevel: cd to repo root. Python: ALLOWED host set; over every line (comments included) of every Swift file under Emuqu (whole app target) and the watch app (a missing root -> exit 2) collects hosts from `http(s)://host` literals and from bare host strings `.host = "x"` / `host: "x"`; unknown hosts -> exit 1. Hosts a user types at runtime are out of scope by design (header). Then grep BANNED SDK names in project.pbxproj and Package.resolved (count != 0 -> exit 1). Then grep `^import Zip$` / Zip.unzipFile etc. (hit -> exit 1) and updateFirmware/firmwareUpdate/PolarFirmwareUpdate (hit -> exit 1). Wired: gates.yml (no-phone-home), ci.yml, Makefile.
